entries.en: Added `claude mcp login <name>` and `claude mcp logout <name>` to authenticate MCP servers from the CLI without opening the interactive `/mcp` menu, with `--no-browser` stdin redirect support for completing over SSH
entries.zh: 添加了`claude mcp login <name>`和`claude mcp logout <name>`，以从 CLI 验证 MCP 服务器，而无需打开交互式`/mcp`菜单，并通过`--no-browser`标准输入重定向支持通过 SSH 完成

entries.en: Added status filtering (press `f`) to the `/workflows` agent detail view
entries.zh: 添加状态过滤（按`f`）到`/workflows`代理详细信息视图

entries.en: Added a "Skills" section to the `/plugin` Installed tab
entries.zh: 在`/plugin`已安装选项卡中添加了“技能”部分

entries.en: Added `teammateMode: "iterm2"` setting with a warning when auto mode cannot find the `it2` CLI
entries.zh: 添加了 `teammateMode: "iterm2"` 设置，并在自动模式找不到 `it2` CLI 时发出警告

entries.en: Added "Claude Platform on AWS - refresh credentials" option to `/login` when `awsAuthRefresh` is configured
entries.zh: 配置`awsAuthRefresh`时，在`/login`中添加了“AWS 上的 Claude Platform - 刷新凭证”选项

entries.en: `!` bash commands now trigger Claude to respond to the output automatically; set `"respondToBashCommands": false` in settings.json to keep the previous context-only behavior
entries.zh: `!` 开头的 bash 命令现在会触发 Claude 自动对输出作出回应；如需保留之前仅作为上下文的行为，请在 settings.json 中设置 `"respondToBashCommands": false`

entries.en: Improved `claude mcp get` and `claude mcp remove` to suggest the closest configured server name on a typo and truncate long server lists
entries.zh: 改进 `claude mcp get` 和 `claude mcp remove`：拼错服务器名时，建议最接近的已配置名称；服务器列表过长时会截断显示

entries.en: Improved memory: the agent is now reminded to compact its `MEMORY.md` index when nearing the size limit
entries.zh: 改进内存：接近大小上限时，会提醒 agent 压缩其 `MEMORY.md` 索引

entries.en: Improved skill frontmatter: `display-name`, `default-enabled`, `fallback`, and `metadata.*` keys now accept kebab-case, snake_case, and camelCase
entries.zh: 改进技能 frontmatter：`display-name`、`default-enabled`、`fallback` 和 `metadata.*` 等键现在支持 kebab-case、snake_case 和 camelCase 三种写法

entries.en: Improved malformed `SKILL.md` YAML frontmatter handling: loads the skill body with empty metadata instead of failing silently
entries.zh: 改进 `SKILL.md` 的 YAML frontmatter 格式错误处理：以空元数据加载技能正文，而不是静默失败

entries.en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` to cap at 15; for unattended sessions, use `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` instead
entries.zh: 将 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES` 更改为上限为 15；对于无人值守会话，请改用`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`

entries.en: Changed background subagents to surface permission prompts in the main session instead of auto-denying; the dialog shows which agent is asking, and Esc denies just that tool
entries.zh: 将后台子代理更改为在主会话中显示权限提示，而不是自动拒绝；对话框显示哪个代理正在询问，Esc 拒绝该工具

entries.en: Changed `/review <pr>` to use the same review engine as `/code-review medium`
entries.zh: 更改了`/review <pr>`以使用与“/code-reviewmedium”相同的审核引擎

entries.en: Fixed streaming requests failing with "Content block not found" or JSON parse errors after the machine wakes from sleep
entries.zh: 修复了机器从睡眠状态唤醒后，流请求因“未找到内容块”或 JSON 解析错误而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagent transcript scroll position bleeding into the main transcript on exit
entries.zh: 修复了退出时子代理记录滚动位置渗入主记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed background task previews flashing raw tool names before the agent's plan loaded
entries.zh: 修复了后台任务预览在加载代理计划之前闪烁原始工具名称的问题

entries.en: Fixed Chrome tab-group isolation not applying when the in-product permissions gate is off for concurrent CLI sessions
entries.zh: 修复了当并发 CLI 会话的产品内权限门关闭时 Chrome 选项卡组隔离不适用的问题

entries.en: Fixed background session recaps being duplicated; the agent's own end-of-turn summary now shows as the recap line
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话回顾重复的问题；代理自己的回合结束摘要现在显示为回顾行

entries.en: Fixed opening a background session from `claude agents` leaving the previous screen painted behind it
entries.zh: 修复了从“claude Agents”打开后台会话并将前一个屏幕绘制在其后面的问题

entries.en: Fixed `Agent(type)` deny rules and `Agent(x,y)` allowed-types restrictions not being enforced for named subagent spawns
entries.zh: 修复了`Agent(type)`拒绝规则和`Agent(x,y)`允许类型限制未对命名子代理生成强制执行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc and Ctrl+C not responding while background agents are still running after the main turn ends
entries.zh: 修复了主回合结束后后台代理仍在运行时 Esc 和 Ctrl+C 没有响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed misaligned option numbers in permission prompts when the option text overflows
entries.zh: 修复了选项文本溢出时权限提示中选项编号未对齐的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing `x` on a finished subagent in the agent panel not dismissing it
entries.zh: 修复了在代理面板中按已完成的子代理上的`x`不会将其关闭的问题

entries.en: Fixed a misleading "MCP server disconnected" notice for intentionally retired tools when resuming older sessions
entries.zh: 修复了恢复旧会话时故意停用的工具的误导性“MCP 服务器已断开连接”通知

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Installed showing a "more above" indicator when already scrolled to the top
entries.zh: 修复了已安装的`/plugin`在滚动到顶部时显示“更多上方”指示器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `~~strikethrough~~` showing literal tildes in assistant messages instead of rendering as strikethrough
entries.zh: 修复了“~~删除线~~”在助理消息中显示文字波浪线而不是呈现为删除线的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--tools` allowing feature-gated tools to slip through before flags loaded on a cold first launch
entries.zh: 修复了`--tools`，允许功能门控工具在首次冷启动时加载标志之前滑过

entries.en: Fixed background job status in `claude agents` showing a stale "needs input" message after replying
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德代理”中的后台作业状态，在回复后显示陈旧的“需要输入”消息

entries.en: Fixed a dark-theme flash when opening a background session from `claude agents` on a light terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在轻型终端上从“克劳德代理”打开后台会话时出现的深色主题闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse-selected text staying highlighted after deleting it in `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了在“克劳德代理”中删除鼠标选择的文本后保持突出显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed session cost not showing for usage-based Enterprise and Team subscribers
entries.zh: 修复了基于使用情况的企业和团队订阅者不显示会话成本的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: teammates spawned via tmux/pane backends now inherit the leader's `--effort` level
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：通过 tmux/pane 后端生成的队友现在继承领导者的`--effort`级别

entries.en: Fixed Workflow `agent({schema})` subagents looping forever on repeated schema validation failures instead of aborting after 5 attempts
entries.zh: 修复了工作流程`agent({schema})`子代理在重复的架构验证失败时永远循环，而不是在 5 次尝试后中止
